newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Pacific Andes says offer 1.65 times subscribed.
newsitem.headline: Pacific Andes says offer 1.65 times subscribed.

text.p: Pacific Andes (Holdings) Ltd said on Thursday the 17.1 million shares available to the public in its initial public offer (IPO) in Singapore were subscribed by approximately 1.65 times.
The company also said in a statement that applications for 36.8 million shares in the 42.9 million placement tranche were received.
The balance of 6.1 million placement shares would be available to meet over-subscription of the offer shares tranche.
The group trades in frozen seafood products and related businesses.
Total application monies received amounted to about US$37.8 million, Pacific Andes said. Pacific Andes is owned by Hong Kong's Pacific Andes International Holdings.
